title: Kuwait Air Force Commander Visits Türkiye; Turkish Air Chief Heads to Pakistan Next
excerpt: Türkiye's Air Force commander is hosting his Kuwaiti counterpart on 11-14 November and will pay an official visit to Pakistan on 16-19 November, the defence ministry says.
